'''Quadrant B-85''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was the location of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] counter-terrorism operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was known as the Retail sector.<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
